question: Refer to the exhibit. A switch receives a Layer 2 frame that contains a source MAC address of 000b.a023.c501 and a destination MAC address of 0050.0fae.75aa. Place the switch steps in the order they occur. (Not all options are used.)
definitions: The switch adds the source MAC address to the MAC address table.
The switch adds the destination MAC address to the MAC address table.
Because the destination is not known, the switch forwards the frame out all ports except the port through which the frame arrived.
Because the source MAC address is not known, the switch broadcasts the frame out all ports except the port through which the frame arrived.

correct_pairs.occurs first: The switch adds the source MAC address to the MAC address table.
correct_pairs.occurs second: Because the destination is not known, the switch forwards the frame out all ports except the port through which the frame arrived.

notes: Two pictures: the exhibit (MAC address table, kept as the question picture) and the answer. Checked against the exhibit: neither 000b.a023.c501 nor 0050.0fae.75aa is in the table, so the switch learns the source and floods. Agrees with the explanation.

question: Match the IEEE 802.1Q standard VLAN tag field with the description. (Not all options are used.)
definitions: a value that supports level or service implementation
a value for the tag protocol ID value
an identifier that enables Token Ring frames to be carried across Ethernet links
a value for the application protocol of the user data in the frame

correct_pairs.Type: a value for the tag protocol ID value
correct_pairs.User Priority: a value that supports level or service implementation
correct_pairs.Canonical Format Identifier: an identifier that enables Token Ring frames to be carried across Ethernet links

notes: Hand-drawn-line picture; 'a value for the application protocol of the user data in the frame' is the unused box. Agrees with the explanation.

question: Match the DTP mode with its function. (Not all options are used.)
definitions: Passively waits for the neighbor to initiate trunking
Requires manual configuration of trunking or nontrunking
Actively attempts to convert the link to a trunk

correct_pairs.Nonegotiate: Requires manual configuration of trunking or nontrunking
correct_pairs.Dynamic desirable: Actively attempts to convert the link to a trunk
correct_pairs.Dynamic auto: Passively waits for the neighbor to initiate trunking

notes: Letter-style picture (A-A, B-B…). All four used even though the question says not all options are used. Agrees with the explanation.

question: Match each DHCP message type with its description. (Not all options are used.)
definitions: a client initiating a message to find a DHCP server
a DHCP server responding to the initial request by a client
the client accepting the IP address provided by the DHCP server
the DHCP server confirming that the address lease has been accepted

correct_pairs.DHCPDISCOVER: a client initiating a message to find a DHCP server
correct_pairs.DHCPOFFER: a DHCP server responding to the initial request by a client
correct_pairs.DHCPREQUEST: the client accepting the IP address provided by the DHCP server
correct_pairs.DHCPACK: the DHCP server confirming that the address lease has been accepted

notes: Arrow-style picture; DHCPNACK is the leftover. The explanation's text says 'the lease has been accepted'; the picture says 'the address lease has been accepted' (picture kept). Same picture as the Final's Q97.
